responsibility: This header contains the primary machine macros, architectural definitions, and target configuration interfaces for the NDS32 backend. It defines register-number ranges, alignment and addressing classifications, ABI and calling-convention constants, assembler-output macros, jump-table behavior, target feature tests, and other pervasive compile-time policies that nds32.cc and the machine descriptions rely on, serving as the principal target header for the port.
same_name_distinction: Within the nds32 same-name set, this header is the compile-time definition layer: it provides the target macros, enums, register numbering, ABI/alignment/addressing constants, and assembler interface definitions consumed by nds32.cc and referenced by the md descriptions, rather than implementing hooks, patterns, or option tables itself.
